method: Nine structurally distinct directions scored independently against operator tasks and fatal-flaw gates. Scores are design-analysis estimates, not user-study measurements.

directions.name: Evidence Control Plane
directions.mentalModel: A run is a chain of claims, authorities, and evidence.

directions.name: Operational Command Map
directions.mentalModel: A live map of jobs, workers, queues, and recovery debt.

directions.name: Dependency Graph Workspace
directions.mentalModel: Tasks and agents are a navigable DAG.

directions.name: Verification Dossier
directions.mentalModel: Each run is an auditable case file.

directions.name: Multi-Pane Engineering Cockpit
directions.mentalModel: Persistent simultaneous views of state, evidence, and action.

directions.name: Canonical Document Workspace
directions.mentalModel: Decisions and tasks are executable documents.

directions.name: Recovery-First Operations Console
directions.mentalModel: Every state is organized around safe recovery actions.

directions.name: Human-Authority Control Surface
directions.mentalModel: The primary object is the boundary between machine proposal and human authority.

selectedThesis: Evidence Control Plane with Recovery-First Operations and a Human-Authority boundary. Completion, verification, release readiness, and runtime health remain visually and semantically separate.
limitations: Scores are not blind user-study data.
Browser visual regression and real keyboard/screen-reader testing remain blocked.
The legacy application shell is not fully replaced.
